extracted.name: Chipotle sauce
extracted.description: Rustle up this tangy, spicy sauce in just five minutes to slather over burgers, or serve with chips or wedges for dunking
instruction_lines: Tip the yogurt in a bowl and mix with the mayo, 1 tbsp chipotle paste, the syrup, garlic powder and lime zest. Stir in some lime juice and a little extra chipotle paste to taste.
